Use the data API to create two synthetic public CollaborationGroup records and sort their IDs. Create three LightningOnboardingConfig records with unique DeveloperName and MasterLabel values, with CollaborationGroupId null, lower and higher respectively. Re-query the three references and identify records as N, L, H. At each API version query the three records with ORDER BY CollaborationGroupId NULLS FIRST, NULLS LAST, ASC, DESC, and DESC NULLS LAST. Apex DML does not support creating this object.
